resources.string: Gmail access for %1$s expired or was revoked.

The assistant uses Google\'s Gmail API with the permission you grant in your browser. It never reads other apps\' data. It can search, read, sort and draft on its own; sending and moving to Trash always wait for your approval here or on the web.
Disconnect Gmail? Access is revoked and requests waiting for approval are removed. Drafts stay in Gmail.
Gmail is not set up on this server yet. Ask the platform administrator.
Mailbox tools are available to owners and admins of this chatbot\'s organization. Your role doesn\'t include them.
That sign-in link didn\'t match a connection started on this device, so nothing changed.
Nothing is waiting. Emails the assistant drafts and messages it wants to trash appear here for you to approve.
Failed — nothing was sent or trashed
These messages will be moved to Trash (Gmail keeps them for 30 days):

resources.string: Send this email to %1$s now? This can\'t be undone.
This draft no longer exists in Gmail, so it can\'t be sent.
Review carefully. Text the assistant drafted may quote emails written by other people.
The draft or messages changed since you opened this. Review the current version, then approve again.
This request was already handled, possibly on another device.
Declined. A drafted email stays in Gmail Drafts.
Declined. These messages were not moved to Trash.
Gmail refused the request. Nothing was sent or trashed.
The connection to Gmail failed mid-request, so it may or may not have happened. Check Gmail before asking again; it will not be retried automatically.
The draft is gone from Gmail, so the email was most likely sent. Check your Sent folder.
The draft is still in Gmail, so the email was most likely not sent.
Choose a time at least a few minutes ahead and within 60 days.
The server sends the email at about this time (within about 10 minutes). If the draft is edited in Gmail before then, it is not sent.
Send this exact email to %1$s on %2$s?
Scheduled. The email has not been sent yet.
Schedule cancelled. The email is waiting for your approval again.
You approved this email for later. It has not been sent. You can still cancel the schedule or keep it as a draft.
